from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Core Concept: Diffusion Models", [
            "Diffusion models learn to reverse Gaussian noise.",
            "Images dissolve into pure random noise states.",
            "Reverse process subtracts noise to recover images.",
            "It is like un-blurring a photograph.",
            "The image re-emerges from the static."
        ])

        # Animation objects
        noise_box = Square(side_length=1.5, fill_opacity=0.5, color=WHITE)
        noise_label = Text("Noise", color="#FFFFFF", font_size=24)
        noise_group = VGroup(noise_box, noise_label).arrange(DOWN)
        
        signal_box = Square(side_length=1.5, fill_opacity=0.5, color=YELLOW)
        signal_label = Text("Signal", color="#FFFF00", font_size=24)
        signal_group = VGroup(signal_box, signal_label).arrange(DOWN)
        
        arrow = Arrow(start=LEFT, end=RIGHT, color="#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.place_at_grid(noise_group, 'C5', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(noise_group))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FFFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.place_at_grid(signal_group, 'C3', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(signal_group))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.place_at_grid(arrow, 'C4', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Iterative denoising highlight
        highlight = SurroundingRectangle(signal_group, color="#FF00FF", buff=0.1)
        self.play(Create(highlight))
        self.lecture[3].set_color("#FF00FF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        model_label = Text("Diffusion Model", color=WHITE, font_size=20)
        self.place_at_grid(model_label, 'D4', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Write(model_label))
        self.lecture[4].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "CLIP maps text and images into shared space.",
            "Semantic similarity brings vectors close together.",
            "Text and images align in mathematical space."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Bridging Text and Vision: CLIP", lecture_lines)
        
        # Define colors from storyboard
        text_color = "#00FFFF"
        image_color = "#FF00FF"
        align_color = "#FFFF00"
        math_color = "#FFFFFF"
        loss_color = "#FF0000"

        # Initialize objects (once)
        text_vec = Dot(color=text_color)
        text_label = Text("Text Vector", font_size=18, color=text_color)
        text_group = VGroup(text_vec, text_label).arrange(DOWN)
        
        image_vec = Dot(color=image_color)
        image_label = Text("Image Vector", font_size=18, color=image_color)
        image_group = VGroup(image_vec, image_label).arrange(DOWN)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(text_color))
        self.place_at_grid(text_group, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(image_group, 'E5', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(Create(text_group), Create(image_group))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(image_color))
        
        # Move them closer together
        target_pos = self.grid['C4']
        self.play(
            text_group.animate.move_to(target_pos + UP*0.2),
            image_group.animate.move_to(target_pos + DOWN*0.2)
        )
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(align_color))
        
        align_line = Line(text_vec.get_center(), image_vec.get_center(), color=align_color)

        self.place_at_grid(sim_text, 'D2')
        self.play(Write(sim_text))

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("The Mathematics: Probability & Gradients", [
            "Models predict noise residual using U-Net.",
            "We minimize the difference between predicted noise.",
            "Guidance scales balance text and image fidelity.",
            "Move slider to change strictness of prompt.",
            "This defines imagination versus image structure."
        ])
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Visualize probability distribution
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-3, 3], y_range=[0, 1], axis_config={"include_numbers": False}).scale(0.5)
        curve = axes.plot(lambda x: np.exp(-x**2), color="#00FF00")
        self.place_at_grid(VGroup(axes, curve), 'B2', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Create(curve), run_time=1.5)
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight gradient descent
        vec = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=RIGHT*0.5 + UP*0.5, color="#FFFF00")
        self.place_at_grid(vec, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF00")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Show parameter update
        dot = Dot(color="#FF00FF")
        self.place_at_grid(dot, 'D3', scale_factor=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(dot), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF00FF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Plot loss reduction
        loss_curve = Line(LEFT, RIGHT, color=WHITE).scale(0.5)
        self.place_at_grid(loss_curve, 'E3', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Create(loss_curve), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[3].set_color(WHITE)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Math objective
        eq = MathTex(r"L = ||\epsilon - \epsilon_\theta||^2", color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(eq, 'D5', scale_factor=0.7)
        self.play(Write(eq), run_time=1.5)
        self.lecture[4].set_color(WHITE)
        self.wait(2)

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Diffusion models learn the art structure.",
            "CLIP learns the meaning of language.",
            "Together they turn text into pixels."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Summary & Future Outlook", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors for categories
        color_diffusion = "#FF9999" # Light red
        color_clip = "#99FF99"      # Light green
        color_final = "#9999FF"     # Light blue

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # List key model milestones
        milestones = VGroup(
            Text("Latent Diffusion", font_size=24, color=color_diffusion),
            Text("Stable Diffusion", font_size=24, color=color_diffusion),
            Text("ControlNet", font_size=24, color=color_diffusion)
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.place_at_grid(milestones, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(milestones))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(color_diffusion))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Highlight future research directions
        future_research = VGroup(
            Text("Video Synthesis", font_size=24, color=color_clip),
            Text("Efficiency", font_size=24, color=color_clip),
            Text("Semantic Consistency", font_size=24, color=color_clip)
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.place_at_grid(future_research, 'B4', scale_factor=0.6)
        # Shift slightly to avoid overlap
        future_research.next_to(milestones, DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(future_research))
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(color_clip))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Final system summary diagram
        circle1 = Circle(radius=0.5, color=color_diffusion).set_fill(opacity=0.3)
        label1 = Text("Diffusion", font_size=20)
        system1 = VGroup(circle1, label1)
        
        circle2 = Circle(radius=0.5, color=color_clip).set_fill(opacity=0.3)
        label2 = Text("CLIP", font_size=20)
        system2 = VGroup(circle2, label2)
        
        system = VGroup(system1, system2).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1)
        self.place_at_grid(system, 'E4', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(DrawBorderThenFill(system1), Write(label1))
        self.play(DrawBorderThenFill(system2), Write(label2))
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(color_final))
        self.wait(2)

outline.topic: The Magic of AI Painting: From Text to Pixels
outline.target_audience: University students with a basic interest in AI and mathematics

sections.title: The Core Concept: Diffusion Models (0-1 min)
sections.content: Introduce the forward process (adding Gaussian noise to an image until it is static) and the reverse process (learning to subtract noise to recover the image). Use the metaphor of 'un-blurring a photograph'.
sections.example: Visualizing a clear photo of a Golden Retriever slowly dissolving into white noise, then reversing the animation to show the image 're-emerging' from the static.

sections.title: Bridging Text and Vision: CLIP (1-2 min)
sections.content: Explain how CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) maps text and images into a shared mathematical 'latent space'. If text and image are semantically similar, their vectors are close together.
sections.example: An animation showing a text label 'A cybernetic cat' and an image of a robot-cat being dragged toward each other in a 3D coordinate system, snapping into the same point.

sections.title: The Mathematics: Probability & Gradients (2-3.5 min)
sections.content: Simplify the math: The model predicts a 'noise residual' via a U-Net. We represent the pixel state as a vector 'x'. We use a loss function L = ||ε - ε_θ(x_t, t, context)||², where we minimize the difference between actual noise and predicted noise.
sections.example: A graphical slider showing a 'guidance scale'; moving it changes how strictly the model follows the text prompt versus its own 'imagination' of the image structure.

sections.title: The Synthesis: Putting it Together (3.5-4.5 min)
sections.content: Explain the iterative generation process: CLIP provides the 'direction' (the prompt guidance), and the Diffusion process provides the 'steps' (denoising).
sections.example: A real-time progress bar: at Step 10, the image is a blurry cloud; at Step 50, the sharp details of a steam-punk watch emerge based on the input text.

sections.title: Summary & Future Outlook (4.5-5 min)
sections.content: Recap the synergy: Diffusion models learn the 'structure' of art, while CLIP learns the 'meaning' of language.
sections.example: A final visual of a user typing 'Astronaut on a horse' and the system generating a high-fidelity image in seconds.
